messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: AcmeCorp needs onboarding next week if we can accept payment today. Procurement offered corporate card but legal insists on a wet-signed SOW. Risk: onboarding slips.

jordan_sales: They asked for 9-month term vs 12 on the call. Confirmed pro-rate only, no discount requested.

sam_rev_ops: Finance: annual list $45k -> 9mo pro-rate $33,750. We'll need billing entity and PO if they want.

maria_cs: Procurement (Aaron M.) can provide CC now via secure form. He says legal routing for signature could be 7-10 business days.

lee_legal: We can allow payment to trigger limited onboarding tasks but need a short amendment: payment triggers non-production onboarding; signed SOW required within 30 days for full provisioning. Ill draft. Need signer name.

anya_enable: Enablement can do kickoff scheduling, invite lists, basic workspace prep after payment clears. No data migration or dedicated capacity until countersign.

ops_bot: billing-system: Invoice INV-AC-0916 created (https://billing.example/inv/INV-AC-0916) :page_facing_up:

sam_rev_ops: Proposed actions: accept CC, process INV-AC-0916, legal drafts 30-day amendment to allow partial onboarding on payment. OK?

lee_legal: OK. Ill prepare a one-paragraph amendment and send via DocuSign. Will include default clause and signer fields. Return by EOD tomorrow.

jordan_sales: I'll confirm with Aaron that 9mo pro-rate is acceptable and get signer contact.

maria_cs: If payment posts today, enablement will schedule kickoff this week. I'll update once signer info is in. :thumbsup:
